feedback.problem: Which equation describes the set of all points $(x,y)$ in the coordinate plane that are a distance of $8$ units from the origin?
feedback.worked_solution:
The set of all points $(x,y)$ that are a distance of $8$ units from the origin defines a circle with radius $r=8$ centered at the origin, as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13956996/assets/9490799dc8048e1ff6ef30d933afd909cb4932bbe4a4d20cc6b6192384c30554.png)

So, the required equation is

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & ={r}^{2} \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & ={8}^{2} \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & =64.\end{aligned}
$$
